تكالمت (form VI)
# تَكَالَمْتُ (takālamtu) /ta.kaː.lam.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# تَكَالَمْتَ (takālamta) /ta.kaː.lam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# تَكَالَمْتِ (takālamti) /ta.kaː.lam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَالَمَ (takālama)
# تَكَالَمَتْ (takālamat) /ta.kaː.la.mat/: third-person fem
